Vendored from https://github.com/NVlabs/flip
Commit: b475eb4bf394ab877c42166c9eb0a84a02cc5b14
Tag: FLIP v1.7

Files copied (CPU-only subset):
  - src/cpp/FLIP.h   (single-header C++ FLIP reference implementation,
                      includes the LDR + HDR evaluator, image class, magma
                      colour map, etc. The CUDA paths are gated behind
                      #ifdef FLIP_ENABLE_CUDA which we never define.)
  - LICENSE          (BSD-3-Clause)

Files intentionally omitted:
  - src/cpp/tool/    (FLIP-tool.cpp, FLIPToolHelpers.h, commandline.h,
                      filename.h, imagehelpers.h, pooling.h — the
                      standalone CLI tool, irrelevant for library use)
  - src/cpp/tool/stb_image*.h, tinyexr.h
                      (image-on-disk I/O — we vendor stb_image_write
                      separately under vendor/stb/ for our PNG output and
                      don't need the EXR/HDR readers)
  - src/cpp/FLIP-tool.cu, src/cpp/FLIP.sln, src/cpp/CMakeLists.txt
                      (CUDA build, MSVC solution, build glue)
  - src/cuda/, src/python/, src/pytorch/, src/flip_evaluator/,
    src/tests/, src/nanobindFLIP.cpp
                      (other-language bindings and the CUDA path)
  - images/, misc/, .github/, BUILD.bazel, MODULE.bazel, pyproject.toml,
    CMakeLists.txt    (top-level repo glue)

Patches applied: leading-whitespace formatting only. FLIP.h compiles under g++ with
-std=c++17 when FLIP_ENABLE_CUDA is undefined; see vendor/flip/PATCHES.md
(exact formatting patch).

Build integration: src/image_diff/flip_backend.nim instantiates this
header by emitting a single .cpp translation unit (src/flip_wrapper.cpp)
that includes FLIP.h and exposes a small C-ABI wrapper. The C-linkage
shim is what Nim importc binds against.
